question: India celebrated the 76th National Chartered Accountants Day on July 1, 2025. When was the ICAI established?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**1949**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• National CA Day: 1 July.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
India celebrated the **76th National Chartered Accountants Day** on **July 1, 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
The day marks the founding of the **Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)** in **1949**.

 
 
• 
 
**Chartered Accountants (CAs)** were honored for promoting **transparency** and **fiscal discipline**.

 
 
• 
 
The **ICAI** has grown into a **globally recognized body**, contributing to **fiscal policy** and **accounting standards**.
